title: Finite affine ring charts and flatness comparisons for inverse limits
statement: Let $I$ be a directed preorder with $i_0\in I$, and let $D:I^{op}\to\mathrm{Scheme}$ [def-pc-scheme] have affine transition maps [pqf-def-affine-morphism] and limiting cone $(S,p_i)$ [lem-weil-pbc-limit-affine-transition]. Assume $S_{i_0},X_0,Y_0$ are quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and let $f_0:X_0\to Y_0$ be a morphism over $S_{i_0}$ which is locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. Put $J=\{i\in I:i_0\le i\}$ and $j_0=(i_0,\mathrm{refl})$. There exist $n\in\mathbb N$ and charts $a_b$ ($b\in\mathrm{Fin}(n)$) [def-weil-pbc-flat-descent-chart], each consisting of $F_b:J\to\mathrm{CommRing}$, two $F_b(j_0)$-algebras $B_b,C_b$ and a finitely presented algebra map $\phi_b:B_b\to C_b$, such that: if the pullback of $f_0$ along $p_{i_0}$ is flat [def-weil-flat-morphism], every $a_b$ is limit-flat; and for every $j\in J$, if every $a_b$ is stage-flat at $j$, the pullback of $f_0$ along $D(j\to i_0)$ is flat. Here pullback is the fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product]; limit-flat and stage-flat mean flatness [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map] of the map $\mathrm{id}\otimes\phi_b$ after extension of scalars to $\operatorname{colim} F_b$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], respectively $F_b(j)$. This statement asserts no eventual flatness.

proof.text: For each source point choose W,V,U successively inside the inverse images of previously chosen affine opens, using exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset. Compactness of the source and IsCompact.elim_finite_subcover give finitely many triples. Reindex the finite subset with Fintype.equivFin, retaining the source-cover property.
For each triple use exists_flat_descent_chart_comparison to obtain its finite-presentation ring chart and the compatible tensor-spectrum arrow isomorphisms at all stages and the limit.

Flatness at the limit restricts to each chart by IsZariskiLocalAtSource.resLE. Transport flatness through the arrow isomorphism using MorphismProperty.arrow_mk_iso_iff, then apply Flat.SpecMap_iff to obtain limitFlat. Conversely, at each stage, stageFlat and Flat.SpecMap_iff give flatness of every tensor spectrum arrow; transport back through its arrow isomorphism. For each source point select a covering initial U and use the source-open equality to find a covering stage U. Apply IsZariskiLocalAtSource.iff_exists_resLE to obtain flatness of the whole stage map. The empty source is handled by the same compact-cover proof and pointwise criterion.

lean.statement: theorem exists_flat_descent_affine_charts {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) [∀ {i j : Iᵒᵖ} (a : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map a)] (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c) (i₀ : I) [CompactSpace (D.obj (op i₀))] [QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj (op i₀))] (X₀ Y₀ : Over (D.obj (op i₀))) (f₀ : X₀ ⟶ Y₀) [CompactSpace X₀.left] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X₀.left] [CompactSpace Y₀.left] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y₀.left] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f₀.left] : ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ charts : Fin n → FlatDescentChart {i : I // i₀ ≤ i} ⟨i₀, le_rfl⟩, (Flat (((Over.pullback (c.π.app (op i₀))).map f₀).left) → ∀ b, (charts b).limitFlat) ∧ (∀ j : {i : I // i₀ ≤ i}, (∀ b, (charts b).stageFlat j j.property) → Flat (((Over.pullback (D.map (homOfLE j.property).op)).map f₀).left))
